decisions.reason: As a core upholstery fabric with sustained standalone visibility, it draws directly on the firm's established design and fabric know-how, so management is more likely to refine it through learning than withdraw it.

This decorative fabric remains close to the firm's existing competence base and can be improved from customer and project feedback, though its lighter prominence still makes it somewhat more vulnerable than the strongest lead products.

Its braided structure and dual use in upholstery and curtains fit the firm's accumulated textile knowledge well, and with own-page visibility plus internal R&D capacity it is a plausible candidate for further development rather than early exit.
